info.name: Upfilly Multi-Tenant API Platform (Complete Collection)
info.description:
Complete Postman Collection covering all 316 API endpoints across the Upfilly platform.

### Multi-Tenancy Instructions:
1. Set `{{baseUrl}}` to your API domain (e.g. `http://localhost:6043` or `https://api.upfilly.com`).
2. Set `{{subdomain}}` to your tenant subdomain (e.g. `acme`).
3. After calling `/user/signin` or `/platform/register`, copy the returned JWT token into `{{token}}`.
4. All tenant-scoped requests automatically include `Host: {{subdomain}}.upfilly.com` to route to that business's dedicated database.

variable.description: ID of the active business tenant

item.name: 0. Platform SaaS & Multi-Tenancy (White-Label Control Plane)
item.description: Endpoints for platform business registration, dedicated database provisioning, SaaS plan subscriptions, Stripe billing webhooks, and custom domain setup.

item.name: White-Label 4-Step Resumable Onboarding Flow
item.description: Complete post-plan-selection onboarding flow for White-Label Merchants and Networks. Features 4 resumable steps (Account, Business, Domains, Stripe BYOK), live debounce subdomain availability check, DNS CNAME verification, and branching next steps.

request.description: Debounce-ready live availability check. Validates format (3-30 chars, no leading/trailing hyphen), checks 24-word reserved blocklist, and checks if already claimed across the platform.

item.name: POST /platform/onboarding/step-a (Step A: Minimum Viable Identity & Account Creation)

request.description: Captures minimum viable identity so nothing is lost if the user abandons. Generates a resumable session_token and stores a draft tenant record. whitelabel_type is "merchant" or "network".

item.name: POST /platform/onboarding/step-b (Step B: Business Details & Invoicing / Tax)

request.description: Drives invoicing and tax treatment (ISO-3166 country dropdown, VAT/Tax ID passed for reverse charge). Trading name becomes the default branding name.

item.name: POST /platform/onboarding/step-c (Step C: Subdomain Slug & Network Tracking Hostname)

request.description: Claims the immutable subdomain slug (<slug>.upfilly.com) and generates DNS CNAME instructions for network tracking domain (points to cname.upfilly.com). Does not block onboarding.

item.name: POST /platform/onboarding/step-d (Step D: Stripe BYOK & Dedicated Database Provisioning)

request.description: Bring-Your-Own-Key Stripe connection. Live validation against Stripe API, AES-256 key encryption, automated provisioning of dedicated database (upfilly_tenant_apexmedia on 209.46.122.17), and dynamic branching into Merchant Self-Serve or Network Assisted Zoho Onboarding.

item.name: GET /platform/onboarding/resume (Resume Onboarding Session from Drop-Off Step)

query.description: Session token returned from Step A
Alternatively look up by work email

request.description: Returns saved step and prefilled data so a returning user is resumed at their exact step without repeating previous steps.
Poller to verify whether the customer's tracking hostname CNAME record resolves to cname.upfilly.com.

item.description: Endpoints for the Super Admin "White-Label" tab in the Main Admin Dashboard (backed by db_upfilly). Manages White-Label Dashboard KPIs, Tenants registry, White-Label SubscriptionPlans, Subscriptions, and Transactions.
